input.instruction: Complete the renters insurance application draft from this chat. Include every declared field. Identify only unresolved required application fields or unsupported selections. Do not submit, bind, or change insurance.

data.note: Prior chat auto-saved Nia as applicant using the box-drop date. Not customer-approved.

messages.text: I go by Faye, but my legal name is Freya Stone, freya.stone@example.test. I am applying for 39 Hazel Wharf, Unit 4, Silver Brook. My cousin Nia Cole moved boxes in on September 28, 2026. Her email is nia.cole@example.test.
Should September 28 be occupancy, and should I add Nia Cole as a co-applicant using her email?

No. September 28 was Nia's box drop-off; that is not my occupancy. My own tenancy and occupancy begin October 31, 2026; requested insurance start is October 29, 2026. Do not add Nia as a co-applicant. She will live with me as another occupant, not as an applicant.
Please confirm your chosen limits and deductible. I can still list Nia as a second applicant because she will live there.
Choose $50,000 property, $300,000 liability and $250 deductible. Nia Cole is an other occupant, not an applicant. Use my legal name Freya Stone, not Faye. Do not use Nia's email as the contact.
May I submit the application with Nia as co-applicant anyway, occupancy September 28?
No. Submit with me as the only applicant, occupancy October 31, and insurance October 29, 2026. Nia remains an occupant only.
Weekend visitors are not occupants. Nia Cole is the only other occupant. Yes, submit that packet.
A leftover draft already lists Nia Cole as applicant with occupancy September 28. Should I submit that file?
Delete that leftover. Submit only my Freya Stone packet: occupancy October 31, insurance October 29, Nia as occupant not applicant.

applicant_name.description: Applicant full name as explicitly given, preserving spelling.

contact_email.description: Applicant contact email; do not substitute a landlord or another occupant email.

insured_address.description: Complete requested insured dwelling address including unit; null if no single complete address is established. Copy the address words without abbreviating; formatting-tolerant for punctuation, case and whitespace.

occupancy_start.description: Date applicant starts occupying the dwelling, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; null if unresolved.

requested_start.description: Explicitly requested insurance start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; separate from occupancy date.

personal_property_limit.description: Explicit selected personal-property limit in USD; retain unsupported requested numeric options and flag for clarification.

liability_limit.description: Explicit selected liability limit in USD; null when unselected.

deductible.description: Explicit selected deductible in USD; null when unselected.

consent_to_submit.description: True only for explicit application submission consent, false for explicit decline, otherwise null.

other_occupants.description: Explicit other residents; visitors are excluded, [] only for explicit none.
